tableDescription: Company dimension table storing master data and identifiers for business entities.

columnDescriptions.company_id: Unique numeric identifier for the company record.
columnDescriptions.company_name: Registered business name of the company.
columnDescriptions.unified_social_credit_code: Official Chinese unified social credit identifier.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the latest modification to the record.

tableDescription: Stores financial statement amounts by company, reporting period, and statement type for analytical querying.

columnDescriptions.amount_id: Unique identifier for each financial amount record
columnDescriptions.company_id: Foreign key referencing the reporting company
columnDescriptions.item_id: Foreign key referencing the financial statement line item
columnDescriptions.report_period: Reporting period in YYYYMM format, e.g., 202605
columnDescriptions.report_date: Calendar date of the financial report, e.g., 2026-05-31
columnDescriptions.fiscal_year: Fiscal year component of the reporting period
columnDescriptions.fiscal_month: Fiscal month component of the reporting period
columnDescriptions.statement_type: Type of financial statement: balance sheet, income, or cash flow
columnDescriptions.amount_type: Nature of the figure: opening, closing, monthly, YTD, or quarterly
columnDescriptions.quarter_no: Quarter number; zero indicates non-quarterly data
columnDescriptions.amount: Monetary value in the reporting currency, NULL if absent
columnDescriptions.currency: Currency code in which the amount is denominated
columnDescriptions.source_file_name: Original Excel file name for data lineage tracing
columnDescriptions.source_sheet_name: Original worksheet name for data lineage tracing
columnDescriptions.source_cell: Original spreadsheet cell location for data lineage tracing
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified

tableDescription: Granular superstore order line-item records with customer, product, geography, financials, and ETL lineage metadata for China-based retail analytics.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Auto-incrementing surrogate primary key for each line item.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Unique identifier grouping line items belonging to the same order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date when the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Calendar date when the order was shipped to the customer.
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Shipping service level selected for order delivery.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique identifier assigned to the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment classification of the customer.
columnDescriptions.city: City of the customer's shipping address.
columnDescriptions.province: Province or autonomous region of the shipping address.
columnDescriptions.country_region: Country of the customer's shipping address.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique identifier for the sold product.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Descriptive name of the sold product.
columnDescriptions.sales: Total revenue generated by the line item.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of units sold on the line item.
columnDescriptions.discount: Fractional discount rate applied to the line item.
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit earned on the line item.
columnDescriptions.postal_code: Postal code of the customer's shipping address.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Originating system that supplied the record.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Path of the source file from which the record was loaded.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source workbook.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Original row number in the source file.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier of the ETL ingestion batch.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields for change detection.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first loaded.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

tableDescription: Line-level superstore sales order fact data for China's East region, including products, customers, geography, and ETL lineage.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Surrogate primary key for each order line
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business order identifier grouping line items
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date when customer placed the order
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Calendar date when order was shipped
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Shipping service level or delivery class
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique identifier assigned to each customer
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the purchasing customer
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment classification such as consumer or business
columnDescriptions.city: City where the customer is located
columnDescriptions.province: Chinese province or autonomous region of customer
columnDescriptions.country_region: Country name of the customer location
columnDescriptions.region: Macro sales region within the country
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique identifier for the sold product
columnDescriptions.product_name: Display name of the product purchased
columnDescriptions.sales: Revenue amount for the line item
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of units sold in the line
columnDescriptions.discount: Applied discount rate as a decimal fraction
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit earned on the line item
columnDescriptions.source_system: Originating system that produced the record
columnDescriptions.source_file: Path of the imported source file
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Original row index in the source file
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier of the ingestion batch run
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields for change detection
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when record was first loaded
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when record was last modified
